turns.t: Doctor, this is Mr Barnes, forty-six. Sudden hearing loss in the left ear since this morning and he's very dizzy. Obs are done.
I can't hear a thing out of this ear. And the room's spinning, I've been sick twice, I'm really scared.
Mr Barnes, I'm Dr Ellis. I know you're frightened, we're going to look after you. When did it start?
I woke up with it. About six this morning. Muffled, like cotton wool, and then it got worse, and now I hear nothing.
Any ringing or noise in the ear?
A loud hiss. Constant.
Has the spinning been constant?
It comes and goes, but it's bad when I move my head.
Did you bang your head, or have any injury?
No. Nothing at all.
Any allergies to medicines?
None.
Have you had any ear problems before, or other conditions?
I had grommets as a child, in both ears. And migraines.
What work do you do?
I'm a piano tuner. My ears are my living.
Doctor, his observations. Blood pressure 138 over 86, pulse 90, temperature 36.8, oxygen 98 percent, respiratory rate 18.
Thanks, Jade. Mr Barnes, I'm going to test your balance and your hearing. Look at my finger.
Okay. My eyes are jumping, aren't they? ~
They are, there's a little flick when you look to the left. And I'll test your hearing with a tuning fork.
I can't hear it at all on the left.
That fits. Your left ear is not hearing the tuning fork, and your eye movements show a flicker to one side, which fits an inner-ear problem.
What is it? ~
Sudden hearing loss with vertigo like this, in one ear, looks most like sudden sensorineural hearing loss, which needs urgent treatment, ideally within days.
Will I get my hearing back? ~
Many people do, especially if treated quickly, and you've come quickly. That's why I'm acting today. ~
What happens? ~
I'm going to arrange an urgent hearing test, an audiogram, here, this morning.
I'll call audiology now, doctor. ~
I'd also like to arrange an MRI scan of your ears and brain, to rule out other causes.
Is it a tumour? ~
It's very unlikely, but we check. And I'd like to take blood tests, to look for infection and other causes.
Okay. ~
The ENT team will see you today and decide on treatment, and I'd like them to review you again in a few days.
Thank you, doctor. ~
Jade will stay with you. Lie still, and tell her if you feel sick. ~
